description: Alterations including replacing 6 garage units with 4 larger garage units, keeping the rear and side walls and extending to the front.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.
Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed Location Plan, 25002_P05 Rev. A, 25002_P06, 25002_P07, 25002_P08 and a Reasonable Exception Statement.
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the external materials and finished detailed on the approved plans listed on this decision notice.
Reason: In the interest of the character and appearance of the area, and preserving the Conservation Area, in accordance with Council policies LP1 and LP3 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 4 - The construction works associated with the development hereby approved shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the tree protection measures specified in Sections 7 to 12 of the Tree Development Report (BS5837:2012 Arboricultural Impact Assessment and Arboricultural Method Statement) (prepared by Connick Tree Care, 11th August 2025) and Appendix III 'Tree Retention and Protection Plan'. 
Reason: To preserve trees on the site in the interest of visual amenity and to preserve the character and appearance of the Conservation Area, in accordance with Council policies LP3 and LP56 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 5 - Prior to the use of the development hereby approved, the active electric vehicle charging points specified on the approved plans shall be installed and brought into operation, with one active point provided for each garage. The electric vehicle charging points shall thereafter be maintained for the lifetime of the development. 
Reason: To promote sustainable travel and reduce emissions in accordance with London Plan Policy T6, Council policies LP49, LP51 and LP52 coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 6 - The development hereby approved shall be used only for the storage of vehicles (Use Class B8) as defined in the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), and for no other purposes, including any other uses within Use Class B8.  
Reason:  To safeguard the amenity of nearby occupiers and the character of the surrounding area, in accordance with policies LP1, LP2 and LP3 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
